paper_title: Dark Matter Search with a Resonantly-Coupled Hybrid Spin System
notes: 95% C.L. exclusion limits extracted from Figure 4 (gapp_final.pdf). Data from both SC (self-compensation, 0.01-6 Hz) and HSR (hybrid spin resonance, 3-1000 Hz) regimes merged into single curve, taking stronger limit in overlap region. Unit conversion from paper's g_app (GeV^-1) to canonical dimensionless g_ap using 2m_p rule: g_ap = 2 × m_p × g_app, with m_p = 0.938 GeV. Axion mass from frequency: m_a (eV) = 4.136×10^-15 × f_a (Hz). Extracted via pymupdf vector graphics parsing with axis calibration from text labels.
